biography: Fraser Robertson, a name whispered with rising anticipation in British motorsport, hails from the windswept coast of Scotland. Born into a family with no prior racing connections, his passion ignited during a local hill climb event he attended as a child. The roar of the engines and the smell of burning rubber captivated him instantly. He began karting at 12, quickly demonstrating a natural talent and an uncanny ability to read the track. Despite limited funding, Fraser's unwavering dedication and raw speed caught the eye of Veloce Racing, who offered him a spot in their young driver program. A defining moment came during a rain-soaked junior formula race at Silverstone, where he masterfully navigated treacherous conditions to secure his first podium finish. Now at 23, and known for his level-headedness, Fraser is steadily climbing the ranks, proving himself to be a force to be reckoned with.
drivingStyle: Fraser is known for his methodical and calculated approach to racing. He prioritizes consistency and tire management over outright aggression, often biding his time and capitalizing on the mistakes of others. He possesses a remarkable ability to maintain composure under pressure, rarely making rash decisions. While not the flashiest driver on the grid, his smooth inputs and precise lines allow him to extract maximum performance from his car without overstressing the tires. He's a master of the long game, preferring to build momentum throughout a race rather than attempting risky overtakes early on.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Dubois
rivalries.reason: A fierce competitor from a rival team, Isabelle's aggressive driving style often clashes with Fraser's more calculated approach, leading to several on-track incidents and heated exchanges.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Kenji, a fellow rising star, has consistently outperformed Fraser in qualifying, fueling a rivalry based on the desire to prove who is the faster talent.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Silva
rivalries.reason: Ricardo blocked Fraser in a crucial qualifying lap, costing him a front-row start. Fraser hasn't forgotten.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, regardless of the weather.
Before each race, meticulously cleans his helmet visor with a specific microfiber cloth.
Listens to classical music to calm his nerves before getting into the car.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about control. Control of the car, control of your emotions, and control of the situation."
careerHighlight: Winning the Formula Renault UK championship in 2022 after a season-long battle, securing the title with a daring last-lap overtake.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Macau Grand Prix due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potentially career-defining victory.
